evidence.quote: The Kestrelwood spectrograph is now calibrated at 88.4 MHz.

We verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it
holds across the full observing band.

observations.why: Unhedged empirical factual assertion backed by reference plates; assertively held but moveable with contrary measurement.

evidence.quote: 88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates

observations.why: Factual metadata recording calibration status as a direct assertion without ratifying an operational rule.
